description: Get details of a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). Set include_summaries=true for deployment/commit/approval summaries. To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

include_summaries.description: If true, include deployment_summary, commit_addition_summary and approval_summary (extra API calls, larger response). Default false to reduce token usage.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

name: get_merge_request
